resources.string: Notifications for Employee Mark IN, Mark OUT, and Shift Reminders
Location access is required to verify your plant GPS coordinates and calculate distance during Mark IN and Mark OUT.
Photo and Camera permissions are needed to take profile pictures, upload leave receipts, and attach voucher documents.
Enable notifications to receive instant Mark IN, Mark OUT confirmations, and timely shift reminders directly on your device.
Location access is permanently disabled. Please enable Location from App Settings to mark attendance.
Storage and Camera access is permanently disabled. Please enable Photos/Camera from App Settings.
Notifications are permanently disabled. Please enable Notifications from App Settings to receive attendance alerts.
